data_quality.notes: Air India cabin baggage, domestic allowances, and excess charges were rechecked 2026-09-27. Baggage depends on cabin, fare, route, weight-versus-piece concept, prepaid versus airport excess, Maharaja Club tier, sports handling, and operating carrier.

fees.conditions: 1 cabin bag plus 1 small personal item. Economy/Premium Economy: 7 kg; Business/First: 10 kg.

fees.conditions: Domestic Economy Value includes 15 kg, Classic 20 kg, and Flex 25 kg. The select-route Economy Basic trial also includes 15 kg.

data_quality.notes: Passengers with less than 25 kg of free allowance are limited to one checked piece; those with at least 25 kg may check two. International, interline, codeshare, and Air India Express rules can differ.
